DIAGNOSIS READY: Lumbar Radiculopathy (likely L5 or S1 nerve root compression).

Given your description of pain radiating down the leg, potential weakness, and the neurological exam findings we've discussed, this clinical picture strongly suggests a pinched nerve in the lower spine. If you haven't already had one, an MRI of the lumbar spine is the most appropriate next step to confirm the level and severity of the disc herniation or stenosis.
